A tiny F-Droid repository hosting Guess Where!, a photo geography game

summary.en-US: Guess where photos come from, with Wikimedia Commons imagery

description.en-US:
Guess Where! shows photographs from Wikimedia Commons, the free media
repository, and challenges you to guess where each one was taken. Five
rounds, up to 5000 points each: tap the world map to drop your pin, and
your score decays the farther you are from the real location.

Photo packs: Whole world (random), Coasts and oceans, Mountains, Cities.
Daily Mix gives day-seeded rounds. After every guess you see the reveal
map, the photographer credit, the license and the file description.

No accounts, no tracking, no ads. Scores and seen-image memory stay on
the device. Map tiles use OpenStreetMap data via osmdroid with an
offline cache. Not affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation.
